title: Learning guitar and tuning by ear
summary: Tom picked up guitar without lessons, playing in the streets, and learned tuning by listening to others; he says he has the tone in his head.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
